paragraph: River Edge is a single-family town, plain and simple. Forty-one detached homes sold over six months at a median of $950,000, with sales running from $590,000 up to $1,900,000, so the median is the number to anchor on. The typical sale is a four-bedroom colonial with two full baths. At a sale-to-list ratio of 1.00, roughly half of homes going above asking, and a median of 21 days on market, this is competitive but not frenzied. Well-priced homes move, and you should expect competition on the good ones. Month to month, the medians swing hard because most months only had four to seven closings, which is too thin to read as a trend. The clearer signal is July's 15 closings, right in line with the usual early-summer volume peak. Only two condo or townhouse sales closed in the same window, not enough to draw any conclusion from. If you want a condo alternative here, you will likely be looking at neighboring towns.
